snippet.title: Froggy Hates Snow | Release Date Reveal
snippet.description:
Digital Bandidos and solo developer Crying Brick today announced that Froggy Hates Snow, the charmingly strange “snowguelike” survival roguelite, will launch for PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch on Thursday, May 7 2026.

In Froggy Hates Snow, players guide a small frog beyond the safety of his heat bubble and into a frozen wilderness filled with treasure, secrets, and danger. By digging through deep interactive snow and reshaping the terrain around them, players uncover gems and upgrades that help them survive longer, push further, and discover more with every run.

Play the demo on Steam and Xbox, and wishlist today!

Steam: https://bit.ly/WishlistFroggy
PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016961
Xbox Store: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/froggy-hates-snow/9PL8DTBFFV0T/0010
